## Vajradeha (CR 8)

**XP** 4,800  
LN Medium humanoid (human)  
**Init** +5; **Senses** Perception +16  


**Defense**


**AC** 24, touch 16, flat-footed 18 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +8 natural)  
**hp** 168 (12d8+72)  
**Fort** +13, **Ref** +11, **Will** +10; +4 vs. mind-affecting and pain  
**Defensive Abilities** hardened flesh, improved evasion  
**DR** 10/adamantine; **Immune** disease, poison; **Resist** acid 5, cold 5, fire 5  


**Offense**


**Speed** 50 ft., climb 30 ft., swim 30 ft.  
**Melee** 2 slams +17/12 (2d6+7/19-20)  
**Special Attacks** lightning speed  


**Statistics**


**Str** 24, **Dex** 20, **Con** 21, **Int** 11, **Wis** 18, **Cha** 7  
**Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +16; **CMD** 32  
**Feats** Deflect Arrows, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Improved Critical (slam), Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Weapon Focus (slam)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Endurance is part of Toughness.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +16, Climb +21, Perception +16, Survival +10, Swim +10; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Acrobatics  
**Languages** Common  
**SQ** extreme endurance  


**Special Abilities**


**Extreme Endurance (Ex)** A vajradeha gain double the normal bonus on checks and saves from the Endurance feat (+8 instead of +4).  

**Hardened Flesh (Ex)** A vajradeha gains a bonus to their natural armor equal to their Constitution modifier (+5 for most vajradehas, for a total of +8 natural armor bonus).  

**Lightning Speed (Ex)** A vajradeha can make iterative attacks with their slams, making a typical vajradeha able to attack four times in a full attack.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** solitary, pair, group (3–5), school (6–12), or assembly (13+)  
**Treasure** standard
